mechanism_narrative: A higher current unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated joblessness signals weak consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5 percentage points triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as aggressive monetary easing boosts liquidity and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face dual demand and supply pressures.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 3%), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to central bank tightening expectations and reduced real returns on equities.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of high inflation regime instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as robust residential construction activity signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is above 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it signals a housing market collapse that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as financial sector stress and reduced consumer spending weigh on equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a dovish monetary policy response to economic distress, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate central bank support.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below -50,000, it signals a sharp labor market deterioration that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate hiring freezes and reduced consumer spending pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
